ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 35% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated on distal lobes and 65% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels covering the central isthmus and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions on the lateral margins of both lobes. Left lobe white region (approx. x=100-250, y=450-650) contains dense vertical black linear striations. Right lobe white region (approx. x=750-950, y=300-500) contains sparse diagonal black marks. Central region is a solid low-intensity black mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations visible along the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley amplitude increases towards the distal tips, showing irregular saw-tooth pixel variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge trajectory with a sharp upward sweep towards the distal tips; leading edge exhibits a smooth convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized circular high-intensity clusters (barnacle colonies) present at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense parallel dark-pixel rake marks visible on the white field of the left lobe; two distinct long, thin diagonal dark lines crossing the white field of the right lobe; faint gray linear abrasions visible on the central black dorsal-facing surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel rake marks (linear abrasions) across both ventral lobes; prominent barnacle clusters at lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'branching' dark pixel pattern within the white region of the right lobe distal tip.
